title: Firecrawl (page rendering)
description: Firecrawl as gohort's page renderer: it opens a page in its own browser and gives back the page as Markdown, so this machine needs no Chromium. Declared as a service you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Get an API key at firecrawl.dev (it starts fc-; a free plan is available). The credential lands disabled: enable it under API Credentials. The connector lands unapproved: approve it in Admin > Extensions > Connectors and run Test on its row, which reads example.com. Then pick it under Admin > Capabilities > Page Rendering (Browser) as Service: <name>: browse_page, and every fallback to a browser when a plain fetch fails, go through it. Only public web addresses are sent. No price is declared, as it depends on your plan: add a per_call cost to the connector's spec to see what pages cost.
